episode.title: The Good Gyan Episode

chapters.title: Intro: Good Gyan on Twitter? Really?

episode.tagline: Social media may be addictive, even sometimes toxic, but it is almost magical in one gift it gives us: every day, the best minds in the world think aloud for our benefit. And some of us, gentle readers, are listening & taking notes.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit shares nuggets from his Good Gyan folder on Twitter. He shares why he considers those tweets to be good gyan — and Ajay responds to them, and adds his own good gyan!
